prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Official Adoption Certificate"]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn quick shortcuts to interact, chat, or minimize your pet while working.", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime."]
3: ["Existing user? Sign in to restore your saved pets.", "Restore Saved Pet"]
4: ["If your pet does not appear on your desktop, check your taskbar tray or press Alt+P.", "Ensure desktop overlay permissions are allowed in system settings."]
5: ["Sign in with your main email to keep your pet customization and adoption records safely backed up."]
6: ["Use clear, well-lit single-subject photos for the best 3D pet rendering results.", "Supported formats: JPG, PNG under 10MB"]
7: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to adopt a ready companion or craft a custom pet."]
8: ["Welcome Home to Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen."]
9: ["Preparing Your Pet...", "Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information (email address).
